title: benchmarkEvents
responsibility: Parses provider JSON event streams into completed turns with session identity and available usage.

inputs.name: benchmarkEvents.stdout
inputs.description: Newline-delimited provider JSON event output to parse and validate.

inputs.name: codexTurn.events
inputs.description: Validated provider events containing session identity and a completed turn.

inputs.name: claudeTurn.events
inputs.description: Validated provider events containing session identity and a completed turn.

outputs.name: benchmarkEvents
outputs.description: Validated provider events in their original order; blank lines are omitted.

outputs.name: codexTurn
outputs.description: Completed Codex session, reported model and any reported token counts.

outputs.name: claudeTurn
outputs.description: Completed Claude session, reported model and any reported usage and cost.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects malformed event JSON and missing or failed provider completion.
